concerns.text: Task T017a (Implement model loading logic) is listed BEFORE Task T048 (Implement model loading mechanism). T017a depends on the mechanism defined in T048. A consumer (T017a) cannot precede its producer (T048). T048 must be moved to Phase 2 (Foundational) or immediately before T017a.

Task T017c (Implement heuristic routing logic) depends on T018 (Implement fallback logic), but T018 is listed AFTER T017c. The routing logic cannot be implemented before the fallback logic it relies on is defined.

Task T023 (Integrate heuristic execution) is listed BEFORE Task T024 (Implement result aggregation). T023's description explicitly states it 'Depends on T024'. The consumer (T023) precedes the producer (T024), violating the data-flow dependency.

Task T030 (Integrate statistical tests) is listed BEFORE Task T032a/T032b (Calculate false-positive rates). T030's description states it 'Depends on T032b'. The integration task cannot precede the calculation of the metrics it must report.

Task T031 (Generate final report) is listed AFTER T030 but BEFORE T032b is marked complete in the dependency chain. T031 requires the 'false_positive_rate' calculated in T032b. T032b must precede T031.

Task T045 (Data Source Verification) is listed BEFORE T046 (Sample Representativeness check). T046 depends on the validity of the sample verified by T045. While T045 is listed first, T046's description implies it needs the exclusion count updated by T045. Ensure T045 is strictly before T046 in execution order.

Task T037 (Loader Verification) is placed in Phase 2, but T006 (Implement loader) is also in Phase 2. T037 depends on T006. Ensure T006 is executed before T037 within the parallel phase, or split T037 to follow T006 explicitly.
